Good health begins with awareness. 🌿

At Dainik Bhaskar Aarogya Mahotsav 2026, Jiva Ayurveda joined a thought-provoking discussion on preventive healthcare, Ayurveda-led wellness, and the importance of making informed health choices.

As lifestyle disorders continue to rise, the timeless principles of Ayurveda offer a path towards prevention, balance, and long-term wellbeing.

Together, let's move from treating illness to building health. ✨

Day 7

अगर आप अपने हृदय को प्राकृतिक और समग्र तरीके से स्वस्थ रखना चाहते हैं, तो आज ही जिवा आयुर्वेद के विशेषज्ञों से जुड़ें और अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य सलाह प्राप्त करें।

अपने दिल का ख्याल रखें, क्योंकि स्वस्थ हृदय ही स्वस्थ जीवन की पहचान है।

आज से अपनी नींद को प्राथमिकता दें, आपका दिल आपका धन्यवाद करेगा।

क्या आप घंटों एक ही जगह बैठे रहते हैं?

featured_reviews.name: manoj
featured_reviews.review_text:
My name is Manoj , and I have been suffering from back and neck pain due to an L5–S1 slipped disc  and a few herniated discs in the cervical region, which cause frequent episodes of pain. Recently, I also started experiencing tingling sensations in my feet and toes.

In allopathy, the usual treatment options are exercise, painkillers, or surgery. Since the last two are not suitable for long-term relief, I started searching for an Ayurvedic solution and visited a few reputed clinics, including JIVA Ayurveda.

When I first met Dr. Kshirsagar,  at JIVA, he patiently listened to my condition and explained the Ayurvedic approach in detail. He clarified that while MRI results might not show visible improvement or the disc may not “go back in,” the pain and symptoms can be effectively managed through Ayurveda. He prescribed medicines and recommended 10 sessions of Panchakarma therapy. He has good understanding of Ayurveda and tried to give real picture.

Dr. Shrissagar also mentioned that results vary from person to person — some patients recover completely, while others may need continued treatment depending on the body’s response. I decided to proceed with the treatment.

The Panchakarma sessions were conducted by Shri Nilesh, who is a genuinely humble and dedicated therapist. Panchakarma treatment can sometimes feel a little awkward and uncomfortable, so it is very important that the therapist is skilled and makes you feel at ease. Shri Nilesh is very experienced and knows exactly how to make patients comfortable. Thank you, Nilesh ji, for your care and professionalism.

During the sessions, he also explained the importance of a positive attitude and Ayurvedic lifestyle practices. Even when he was unwell one day, he still came to complete my session — that shows his commitment and sincerity.

Since I had planned to visit my hometown for Diwali, I completed the treatment without any breaks. The overall experience at JIVA Ayurveda, Chembur, was excellent. My tingling sensation has reduced by about 80%, and my overall pain has also decreased noticeably. I feel less stressed and more active now.

💡 My Understanding of the Treatment

In Ayurveda, back and nerve problems are generally linked to an imbalance of Vata Dosha. The Panchakarma treatment helps pacify Vata, reduce inflammation, and strengthen the nerves.

Many people have disc bulges but don’t experience pain — this is because their nerves are strong and there is less internal inflammation. Ayurveda focuses on achieving that balance rather than simply fixing the disc. When inflammation reduces and nerves become stronger, the pain and tingling symptoms subside naturally.

It’s also important to continue exercises, follow a healthy diet, and maintain positive habits to support long-term recovery. Reading more about Ayurvedic principles and adjusting one’s lifestyle can further enhance the results.

Kidney Stones: Don't Ignore the Warning Signs

Kidney stones are hard deposits of minerals and salts that form in the kidneys when urine becomes concentrated. They can cause severe pain and significantly affect your daily life if left untreated.

⚠️ Common Symptoms:
✔ Sharp pain in the back, side, or lower abdomen
✔ Burning sensation while urinating
✔ Blood in urine (pink, red, or brown)
✔ Frequent urge to urinate
✔ Nausea and vomiting
✔ Discomfort during urination

Several factors can increase the risk of kidney stones, including dehydration, excessive salt intake, high-protein diets, and inadequate water consumption. Early diagnosis and proper treatment are essential to prevent complications and recurrence.
